visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a white and gray bicolored cat lying on a gray mesh office chair. The cat's face is partially hidden as it rests its head on the edge of the seat. The background shows a wooden desk with some cardboard boxes and household items, lit by bright, natural indoor light. The camera is steady and focuses on the cat's calm posture. (2) A title overlay in white text "撒嬌的YIA" appears in the center of the frame as the cat looks directly into the lens with its green eyes. The cat's ears are slightly twitching, and its pink nose is prominent. The camera angle is slightly high, emphasizing the cat's small size and endearing facial expressions while it remains stationary on the chair. (3) The scene cuts to a low-angle shot showing the cat walking across a light-colored wooden floor. It approaches the legs of a person wearing beige trousers. The cat leans in and rubs its entire body against the person's leg in a display of affection. A subtitle "我要拍拍" appears as the cat circles the person's feet, showing its tail curling slightly. (4) The cat is now seen lying in a gray pet bed placed on a light wood desk surface. The area is cluttered with colorful items, including a blue box labeled "CAN OPENER," pink pamphlets, and small storage bins. The cat opens its mouth wide as if meowing loudly at the camera. The text "早安啊" is displayed beside the cat's head. (5) In a tighter close-up, the cat remains in its pet bed, looking upwards with an expectant gaze. Its whiskers are long and white against its gray and white fur. As it meows again, the text "妳好早" and "哦是妳" appear successively. The lighting remains soft and even, highlighting the texture of the cat's fur and the surrounding stationery. (6) The cat extends one white paw over the edge of the pet bed, reaching toward the camera. It continues to meow with its mouth open, looking directly at the owner. A sequence of subtitles "妳有凍乾嗎?", "拜託", "一口就好", and "拜託~" appear, creating a narrative of the cat begging for treats. (7) The video transitions to a solid pink background with the white logo "好味小姐 LADY FLAVOR" centered on the screen. The text is clean and minimalist, serving as a branded end card for the short video content.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a distinctive, high-pitched cat meow that serves as a transient trigger. Simultaneously, an upbeat electronic background track starts, featuring a steady 120 BPM drum pattern and bright, rhythmic synthesizer chords. The environment is extremely clean with a studio-like silence floor, and no human speech is present. (2) A second, shorter meow occurs, followed immediately by another sharp vocalization from the cat. The BGM remains constant in volume and energy, with a percussive quality that matches the edit. The mix engineer has prioritized the cat's vocal transients, ensuring they stand out clearly above the synth layers. (3) A long, drawn-out meow with a descending pitch contour is heard as the cat interacts with its environment. The BGM continues its repetitive, catchy loop. There are no ambient noises like traffic or wind, suggesting a controlled indoor recording environment. (4) A series of quick, rhythmic meows are heard, punctuating the silence between BGM phrases. The BGM tempo is very stable, providing a cheerful and energetic foundation for the video. The signal-to-noise ratio is very high, with the primary "signal" being the cat sounds and the music. (5) Two more meows occur in quick succession, sounding like a demand or a greeting. The BGM maintains its bright spectral profile with strong high-frequency presence in the synths. No incidental noises like footsteps or rustling are audible, keeping the focus entirely on the cat and music. (6) A final high-pitched meow concludes the vocal performance. The BGM continues for a moment before fading out sharply at the end of the video. The overall audio design is highly stylized, using the cat's natural sounds as rhythmic elements within the branded music track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to engage cat lovers by showing a cute, vocal cat named YIA interacting with its owner. The text overlays personify the cat's meows as requests for attention and treats, specifically referencing freeze-dried products, to promote the 'Lady Flavor' brand in a heartwarming and humorous way.
